name: 2x Money
description: All your cafe income x2, for good.

name: 3x Money
description: All your cafe income x3, for good. Takes the place of 2x Money.

name: 4x Money
description: All your cafe income x4, for good. Takes the place of 3x Money.

name: Long Nap
description: Your cats earn full pay while you are away, for up to 16 hours. Without it they earn half pay for up to 8 hours.

name: VIP
description: +10% cafe money, a VIP chat tag and a gold VIP plate on your cafe sign. Yours to keep.

name: Cat Accessories
description: Dress your cats in bows, hats and more. A dressed cat earns +15%. Yours to keep.

name: Uniform Styles
description: New uniform styles for every cafe job, and +15% cafe money. Yours to keep.

name: Cafe Style
description: A new cafe theme and name tag, +50% cafe money, and rich visitors come 25% more often. Yours to keep.

name: Grand Cafe Theme
description: The grand cafe look: +150% cafe money, twice as many rich visitors and +1 job slot at every tier. Yours to keep.

name: Extra Slot
description: One more job slot in your cafe, so one more cat can work. Yours to keep.

name: Royal Cat
description: Duchess Marzipan joins your cafe and always earns like a Legendary cat from your newest area. Yours to keep, can't be traded.

name: King Cat Pack
description: King Croissant joins your cafe and always earns like a Mythical cat from your newest area, plus a gold crest for your cafe sign. Yours to keep, can't be traded.

name: Golden Pond
description: Your Fish Pond in the Woods makes 2x golden fish. Yours to keep.

name: Second Bait Bowl
description: A second bait bowl in your cafe, so you can run two baits at once. Both bowls share your bowl upgrades. Yours to keep.
